div.head: Abt 34
div.ab: Gif banes blice weorðeþ, III scillingum gebete.

Gif banes blice weorðeþ, III scillingum gebete.
Wenn eines Knochens Blosslegung entsteht, büsse er mit 3 Schillingen.
If the laying bare of a bone occurs, let him pay 3 shillings.
If a bone is laid bare, 3 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
If exposure of a bone occurs, let him pay with 3 shillings.
